title: Nakayama: generators of a finite module over a local ring are detected modulo the maximal ideal
statement: Let $A$ be a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$, let $M$ be a finitely generated $A$-module and $x_1,\dots,x_r\in M$. Then $x_1,\dots,x_r$ generate $M$ as an $A$-module if and only if their images $\bar x_1,\dots,\bar x_r$ generate $M/\mathfrak mM$ as a $\kappa$-vector space (equivalently, the elements $1\otimes x_i$ generate $\kappa\otimes_AM$). More generally, a submodule $N\subseteq M$ equals $M$ iff its image in $M/\mathfrak mM$ is all of $M/\mathfrak mM$.
